featured_reviews.review_text:
What all we things we consider while choosing a carpenter?

They should fit my budget.
They should work properly, (especially when we are living in the house during construction).
They should keep their promises.
They should do their work with honesty and listen to our concerns.

I usually don’t write reviews, but their work was so good that I had to. They finished everything on time without any delays and worked with honesty. I really liked how dedicated they were they put their heart into their work. They were also very polite and patient when answering my mom’s questions, unlike others who get irritated easily.

Thank you so much! I will definitely recommend them to others and would love to give them more contracts in the future without any hesitation.

featured_reviews.name: Ayush Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had ordered a world map for our wall from ofthewoodwork, and unfortunately, our experience has been extremely disappointing.

The world map they installed is not proper. Some parts are already coming out and falling onto the flooring, and several letters are not clearly visible. The finishing and quality are far below expectations.

When we tried to contact the owner, Meet Shah, and his brother about these issues, we did not receive any proper response. Meet Shah repeatedly says that he is out of town and travelling and that he has informed his brother, but neither he nor his brother has taken responsibility or followed up with us. Our calls and messages are being ignored.

Very unprofessional service and a very bad experience overall. I would strongly advise others not to order a world map or any other products from them.

Highly recommend piece.

featured_reviews.name: GAURAV AGRAWAL
featured_reviews.review_text: Ye carpenter bhagoda hain. Mere se advance liya 3000rs in name of material , thoda bohot saman laya aur bhaag gaya. Bola kaam karuga mujhe latkaya aur phir kabhi phone nhi uthaya. Bhaag gaya mere paise le kar. Isle wajah se mera kaam jo urgent tha delay ho gaya. Ulta mere kaam mein 2 cheez thi but ek cheez cancel ho gayi phir bhi maine paise ka kuch nhi bola par ye bhaag gaya  . Isko koi kaam nhi dena. Iska bharosa nhi karna . Baad mein dusre number se phone lagake sach ugalwaya toh bolta mere pass jyada kaam nhi hain isliye nhi kaar raha mera kaam. Pehle jhoot bola mujhe karuga aapka kaam. Aisee logo ke wajah se asli imandaar kaam karne wale logo ka naam kharab hota. Mere 3000rs lekar bhaag gaya.
featured_reviews.review_translated_text: This carpenter is a fugitive. He took Rs 3000 advance from me in the name of material, brought some material and ran away. He said he will do the work, made me leave and never picked up the phone again. He ran away after taking my money. Because of this my urgent work got delayed. On the contrary, there were 2 things in my work but one thing got cancelled, even then I did not say anything about the money but he ran away. Do not give him any work. Do not trust him. Later, when I called him from another number and got the truth out of him, he said that I do not have much work, that is why I am not doing my work. First, he lied, saying he'd do my work. People like this tarnish the reputation of those who do honest work. He took my 3,000 rupees and ran away.
